messages:
mae-devex: Heads up — noticed an odd regression after we shipped the SDK change to the exports map in 4.2.0. A customer sample app running on Cloudflare Workers now fails to import the SDK with:

mae-devex: \`Error: The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.js' does not provide an export named 'default'\`

sam-runtime: Hmm, that sounds like an ESM/CJS interop issue. Which exact export map did we add?

mae-devex: We added conditional exports and a "types" subpath so the package.json looks like: 

mae-devex: ```json
mae-devex: "exports": {
mae-devex:   ".": {
mae-devex:     "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
mae-devex:     "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
mae-devex:     "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
mae-devex:   },
mae-devex:   "./package.json": "./package.json"
mae-devex: }
mae-devex: ```

rui: The customer repro uses a plain `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` in a worker. Cloudflare Workers expects pure ESM, but their bundler (wrangler/webpack/esbuild) sometimes rewrites imports. The error implies the runtime tried to load the CJS file or the mjs doesn't have a default export.

alyssa-eng: Also saw TypeScript complaints in our sample app CI: tsc can't find the typings path for subpath imports — some toolchains don't read conditional "types" inside exports. The quick symptom: 

alyssa-eng: ```
alyssa-eng: error TS7016: Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/sdk'.
alyssa-eng: ```

mae-devex: Repro steps I used (minimal):
mae-devex: - Create worker project
mae-devex: - `npm i @redwood/sdk@4.2.0`
mae-devex: - `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'`
mae-devex: - `wrangler dev` -> runtime error above

sam-runtime: Can you paste the top of dist/index.mjs and dist/index.cjs? might be a missing `export default` in the ESM build.

mae-devex: ESM file starts with: 
mae-devex: ```js
mae-devex: export * from './runtime.js';
mae-devex: export { createClient } from './client.js';
mae-devex: ```

mae-devex: There is no default export, so `import Redwood from ...` will fail. Previously we shipped a default in CJS glue, so consumers doing default imports were tolerated. The new conditional exports route is stricter.

rui: Ah that explains it. So two issues: 1) runtime error for `import default` consumers; 2) some TS toolchains failing to resolve types because they don't honor conditional "types" mapping.

karen-devex: Customer-facing onboarding samples use `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` in many places — we should update samples to named imports or add a default re-export to ESM build for compatibility.

alyssa-eng: Suggested immediate patches:
alyssa-eng: 1) Add `export { default } from './client-default.js'` to dist/index.mjs or create `index.mjs` that sets `export { createClient }` and `export default createClient` semantics.
alyssa-eng: 2) Update package.json exports to include explicit "types" at package root (some tools only look for "types" at top level):
alyssa-eng: ```json
alyssa-eng: "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
alyssa-eng: ```

mae-devex: Workaround for customers: change imports to `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'` or pin to 4.1.x. I'm opening a quick PR to add a compat default export + top-level types entry.

sam-runtime: Also add a note in CHANGELOG and a short blurb in the migration docs. This will bite folks using older bundlers.

deps-bot: Dependabot: Found 1 vulnerable dependency in @redwood/sdk@4.1.9 — not related to exports but pinging for visibility.

rui: For longer term, we should add a test matrix that runs the sample apps on Cloudflare Workers and on Node with esbuild/webpack to catch ESM/CJS regressions before release.

karen-devex: Agreed. I'll schedule a small DX postmortem tomorrow and update the onboarding samples repo once the patch lands. :+1:

mae-devex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/987 (draft) — includes default ESM export and moves types to package root. seeking review from @sam-runtime and @alyssa-eng

sam-runtime: Reviewing now. If green, let's cut 4.2.1 patch release and push note to #general and the docs site.

mae-devex: Thanks — will follow up with a small sample diff we can paste into docs. :rocket:
